allocation.hostname_comparison: DNS case normalized; actual hostname is read from socket

parameters.second_member_order: independent_then_antithetic for seed indices 0,2; antithetic_then_independent for seed index 1

historical_fingerprint_registry.coverage: no registry supplied; this does not claim full historical state disjointness

metrics.rounding_seed_unit: repeated_measurement_within_episode; seeds are not 18 independent samples
metrics.regret_definition: mean FP32 score of selected top30 minus mean FP32 score of FP32 top30; lower is better
metrics.elite_mean_definition: MSE between selected and FP32 top30 action means over flattened actiondim=10
metrics.score_nmse_definition: mean squared score error divided by mean squared FP32 score
metrics.w8_gate_role: single W8 RTN supplies the separate frozen practical dominance gate; it does not tune the mechanism gate

w8_practical_dominance.comparison: W8 RTN one forward versus two-member W4 ensemble; practical_no_go is separate from mechanism verdict

engineering.snapshot_restore: exact torch.equal checked after every member and at run end

primary_regret_reduction.denominator: 先按episode平均3个rounding seeds，再对6 episodes求mean；aggregate independent regret

elite_mean_action_mse.rule: overall antithetic <= independent + tau and <= RTN_W4 + tau

unresolved: fake quantization executes ordinary FP32 operators; no native W4 kernel, memory, speed, training, or teacher-deployment claim
six fresh episodes and three repeated rounding seeds are a bounded screen, not a confirmatory benchmark
